item.title: Upgrading Network in Ireland from 38 kV to 110 kV: Line Design, Standards & Lightning Performance Requirements (Video)
item.description: To effectively address challenges of an ageing 38 kV rural network that requires large scale asset replacement, Ireland’s ESB developed a compact line design to upgrade these lines to 110 kV based on post insulators in a vertical arrangement. This technical lecture presents an overview of international practice related to such upgrading projects and provides insight into the various design considerations and constraints for the new overhead lines. item.title: Harmonization of IEC & IEEE Surge Arrester Test Standards: Current Status (Video)
item.description: A collaborative effort of both the IEC and IEEE surge arrester standards committees is underway to harmonize arrester test standards. The goal is to define a single set of unified requirements that would qualify all surge arresters, meaning that one comprehensive set of tests should demonstrate that an arrester meets minimum standards for use anywhere in the world.
